parsed.explanation: Trans-specific organised targeting dominates: security forces harass, arrest and detain people suspected of being trans, conduct raids and forced sodomy tests, the capital has warned trans people to avoid busy areas, identity cards classify trans people as mentally disordered, and living openly without state-sanctioned surgery/sterilisation is documented as likely to face persecution. Custodial rape in an intelligence-ministry facility shows state-perpetrated severity-4/5 abuse with no discrimination or bias-violence protections or recourse. Sexuality law is secondary here but is actively used as a lever: flogging and death on fourth tribadism conviction, documented executions and 2017/2022 death sentences or threats, and trans women being conflated with gay men. Entry/facilities are undocumented open questions, not exposures, but documented targeting already places this at severe-risk tier, below near-certain execution regimes.
